name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when investing in income-producing properties?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when investing in income-producing properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls include underestimating operating expenses, overestimating rental income, neglecting proper due diligence, and failing to understand local market conditions. Not having a clear exit strategy or adequate reserves for unexpected repairs can also lead to issues. A practical tradeoff is that a higher-yield property might come with higher risks, such as a less stable tenant base or a less desirable location, requiring a careful balance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating expenses, overestimating income, neglecting due diligence, and failing to understand local market conditions or exit strategy.
